select chi.id, chi.menu_name AS menuName, chi.pid AS pid, chi.order_num AS orderNum, chi.path, chi.component, chi.is_frame AS isFrame, chi.is_cache AS isCache, chi.menu_type AS menuType, chi.visible, chi.`status`, chi.perm_id AS permId, chi.icon, chi.create_by AS createBy, chi.create_time AS createTime, chi.update_by AS updateBy, chi.update_time AS updateTime, chi.remark, chi.org_id AS orgId ,fa.menu_name as 'pName',t_sys_perm.name as perm from t_sys_menu chi left join t_sys_menu fa on fa.id = chi.pid left join t_sys_perm on t_sys_perm.id = chi.perm_id where chi.id = #{id}
